title: Peak valuation of two major vertical farming companies that later collapsed

source.name: Bowery Farming and Plenty Unlimited funding/valuation coverage

notes: Bowery Farming was once valued at $2.3 billion before halting all operations in late 2024. Plenty Unlimited raised nearly $1 billion from investors including Jeff Bezos and SoftBank before filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in March 2025.
